goal: Let node operators enforce encrypted v2 transport on clearnet to stop passive surveillance
Prevents leaking cleartext transaction relay over accidental v1 fallbacks without disabling clearnet
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now with no known blocking issues
agreement: Broad support for preventing cleartext leakage and passive snooping on clearnet (mzumsande, dergoegge, ajtowns)
Prior objections on network partitioning and forcing listen=0 were resolved (jonatack, gmaxwell, vasild)
Suggests replacing the non-routable address exception with peer whitelisting (mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because node operators gain an optional protection against passive on-path surveillance and tampering
Prevents cleartext transaction leakage while retaining clearnet connectivity as v2 adoption grows
